answer: Eligibility is earned on the payer side, not from an identity's paperwork. An agent enters the reward pool only after twenty distinct paying counterparties countersign its receipts, each posting a bond of five saffron, forfeited if its approval is later flagged. Clones multiply but cannot conjure customers, so a farm of five hundred aliases needs ten thousand independent buyers, pushing cost onto the demand side where identities cannot be printed. Slashing also sends a ripple outward: approvals from a flagged wallet drop one delta tier, forcing re-verification and slowing the farm.
